ModMetaData.name: RimWard - Anesthesia Not Included
ModMetaData.author: juliusberger00
ModMetaData.description:
A hospital overhaul for RimWorld.
The Rim is full of people about to die in interesting ways. RimWard turns that supply of misfortune into a business: hang out a sign, lay down some beds, and strangers will limp and get drop-podded to your door to have the holes in them fixed. Then they pay you for it.
You decide who gets a bed, who gets a bill, and who gets a polite "have you considered dying somewhere else?" Run a saintly charity ward or a for-profit organ-adjacent meat shop. That is between you and your ideoligion.
== GETTING STARTED == - Open the RimWard tab and press "Hospital Policies...". Tick "Accept patients" (the hospital is closed by default) and set the opening hours (four a day by default). - Build some medical beds. Vanilla, modded or Hospital Beds Gen 2, any of them will do. Optionally place a "patients land here" marker (Architect, Misc) to choose where the drop pods go. - Mass casualty events are an opt-in checkbox in the same dialog.
== FEATURES == - Triage your way: three intake modes. Firehose: patients just show up. Prompt: every case is a letter with name, faction, diagnosis and estimated payment, and you pick Accept or Turn away. Hybrid: letters only for surgery cases and titled nobles. Unanswered offers expire after 1 to 24 hours (default 6), and declining is always free. - A fair malpractice system: you only lose goodwill when it is actually your fault. A death on the operating table, a death during or right after a botched surgery, a death after dismissal, or a patient who dies within an hour of arriving? Not on you. Neglect is. The penalty size and each exemption are settings. - Surgeries that do not give up: a botched operation schedules another attempt, up to 3 times (setting). If it still fails, the patient is released without a penalty. A patient healed by any other means (psycast, another mod, time) does not stay stuck on an obsolete operation. - The discharge verdict: when a patient leaves you get paid and their faction gets an opinion. Goodwill follows how much better the patient feels than on arrival, plus bonuses for a private room, a skilled doctor and real recovery. Operations on patients are never counted as violations, so do what you judge necessary; only the outcome is judged. - Room-quality pay: a private room (9+ cells, one bed) pays 135%, a two-bed room 110%, a barracks with 3+ beds 85%, a hallway even less. A "chief physician" with Medicine 12+ adds 25%. All of it is a slider. - Renown: four tiers, earned by good discharges. Each tier adds 5% to what patients pay. - Difficult clientele: nobles (Royalty) pay 40% more for a private room and 25% less for a shared ward. Tribal factions dislike glitterworld medicine and modern ones sneer at herbs (off, soft or strict). Patients arrive with extra illnesses, chronic conditions, old addictions or a go-juice habit. With Biotech, one in five is a random xenotype. - Two dials: payment from 10% ("almost nothing") through break-even at 100% up to 1000% ("frankly a crime"), or a custom value. Difficulty from 0.5x to 2.0x scales injuries, diseases and complications. - Mass casualty events (opt-in, per map): a pandemic, a raid, a crash or a fire sends a drop-pod load of patients at once, about as many as you have beds. No triage letters. You asked for this. - Contracts: injured visitors and allies on your map offer to pay for treatment. Same accept or turn away letter. - Quality of life: downed patients are carried to a bed by a free doctor, patients cannot treat themselves, and the table lists diagnosis, cure, rating, time and bill for everyone. Dismiss a patient or refuse an operation for good. Dismissing a patient who is not cured bothers colonists whose ideoligion has the Guilty meme. - English and German.
== COMPATIBILITY == - RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. Requires Harmony. On 1.6 Prepatcher is also listed as a dependency; on 1.7 you only need Harmony (Prepatcher does not run there). - Royalty, Ideology and Biotech add content if present. None are required. - Wounds, diseases and cures are read from the game's health system, not from specific mods, so injury and medicine mods should simply work. It does not depend on any of them, and it has not been tested against every one of them. - Multiplayer: not supported. The policy dialog is not synchronised. - Replaces the Hospital mod and its patches (Hospital Fix And Tweak and friends). Please disable those. RimWard is the whole hospital now and will refuse to share the building. - Hospital Beds Gen 2 by the same author is the recommended companion: its healing beds are medical beds, so RimWard uses them automatically, and faster healing means faster turnover. Optional, but they get along nicely.
== WORKS WITH HEARTH & HARBOR == Optional, nothing is required, RimWorld 1.7. With Hearth & Harbor the bed buttons become one: "Use: Colonist / Guest / Patient / Surgery patient". Patients who are up and about (not bleeding, no operation waiting) may wander into its spa while they recover. Both are switches in the RimWard settings. Without Hearth & Harbor nothing changes.
== CREDITS == Built on Adamas's Hospital and assssssqwww's Hospital Fix And Tweak. Enormous thanks to both. Also built with Harmony (Andreas Pardeike) and Prepatcher (Zetrith).
== KEYWORDS == medical tourism, healthcare, clinic, silver income, economy, management, balance, QoL, emergency room, nursing
== TRANSPARENCY == This mod was built with the help of Claude Code, which did the typing while I did the blaming. RimWard is a fork, so it is and stays GPL-3.0 (see LICENSE, full source in the Source folder). Copyright for the code taken over from Hospital stays with Adamas and assssssqwww, copyright for my changes stays with Julius Berger. Use it, change it, share it under the GPL, and anesthesia remains not included. Credit and a mention are welcome, but beyond what the GPL requires, not needed.
